environment.description: ASP.NET Core 7.0 service deployed on ECS Fargate behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with direct TCP passthrough. No application-layer filtering. PostgreSQL 14 backend with the service account having read/write access to all tables. Service exposed on port 443 with TLS termination at the container level.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB with TCP listener on port 443
config.database: PostgreSQL 14, service role has SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on public schema
config.network: Public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443
